meta.project: V12 Titanium - Yapı Sağlığı ve Risk Analiz Platformu

product_overview: On-premise building health and risk analysis platform that combines local ML (concrete strength estimator), fuzzy-logic decision layer and an on-device LLM to produce fast, privacy-preserving risk scores and engineer-style reports. The PRD (pages 1-3) documents a 4-layer architecture (data collection, ML brain, fuzzy logic, generative AI) and validation metrics (R² = 98.1, MPS = 1.33 MPa).
core_goals: Provide fast, on-site building risk estimation to reduce time compared to lab testing
Maintain data privacy by running computation locally (edge/on-premise)
Combine statistical ML (Random Forest), fuzzy logic and generative AI for explainable decision support
Offer high accuracy and validated concrete strength estimates (R² ≈ 98.1 as shown on PRD page 3)
Gracefully handle missing artifacts (model fallbacks) and expose clear validation errors to users
Support integration with local hardware accelerators (GPU) and future mobile/IoT endpoints per roadmap

features.name: Structural Health Analysis
features.description: Calculate a comprehensive building risk score using building inventory data, ultrasonic and Schmidt measurements, ML-based concrete strength estimation, fuzzy logic aggregation and (when available) local LLM-based explanatory reporting. Exposes a health-check endpoint and a single risk-calculation POST endpoint.
user_flows: GET / -> Receive 200 with message string (health check confirms API running)
GET / -> Receive 500 with error message (service unavailable) (error flow)

POST /api/risk-hesapla with valid body {il, ilce, yapimYili, katSayisi, zeminDukkan, bitisik, hasar, kullanimAmaci, kisaKolon, agirCikma, planTipi, bitisikHiza, ultrasonikSesHizi, geriSicramaSayisi, corrosion, zeminSinifi, crackPuan} -> Receive 200 with RiskResponse containing risk_score, concrete_strength_estimate, fuzzy_details (happy path)
POST /api/risk-hesapla with missing required fields (e.g., omit ultrasonikSesHizi) -> Receive 400/422 with validation error listing missing/invalid fields (error flow)

POST /api/risk-hesapla with valid body when local joblib concrete model file is missing -> Receive 200 with RiskResponse and a note indicating model_fallback (system used default C25 concrete estimate) (fallback handling / graceful degradation)
